item.tib: tshe dbang dzA this rigs lnga'i rgyud bskang dbyings lha dgyes bzhed
item.coloph: ces 'di ltar dgos chad ched/ mkho gal che phyir/ rang 'byung 'gyu cha'i grogs kyi (kyis) bskul ngor/ rig stong kun bzang rgyal po la lung zhus te/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bla ming gshen sprul thugs rje nyi ma zhes pas/ g.yu brag seng ge gnam rdzongs kyi (rdzong gi) mdun zhol du bris pa'o/ dge des g.yung drung bon bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
